applicableAreas: Buildings 5, 6, 7, 8 located within potential clearance distance of overhead electric facilities on eastern and southern property boundaries
findings.comment: Buildings 5, 6, 7, and 8 are located within potential clearance distance of overhead electric utility lines visible on the existing conditions survey and shown on the site plan along the eastern and southern property boundaries. No clearance dimensions from building faces to the outside conductor are provided on any plan sheets to demonstrate the required 7 feet 6 inches horizontal sky-to-ground clearance is maintained.

applicableAreas: Buildings 5, 6, 7, 8 with roof overhangs and projections near overhead electric lines on eastern and southern boundaries
findings.comment: Building elevation sheets or detailed section views do not demonstrate that building projections (roof overhangs, eaves, balconies) maintain the required 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance and 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductors of overhead electric facilities along the eastern and southern property boundaries.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1, 2, 7, 8 adjacent to Valley View Road right-of-way with overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Overhead utility lines exist in the Valley View Road right-of-way along the western property boundary. Buildings 1, 2, 7, and 8 are positioned near the western property line adjacent to this right-of-way. No clearance dimensions are provided to demonstrate that these buildings maintain the required 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance and 15-foot radial clearance from the overhead electric facilities in the adjacent right-of-way.

applicableAreas: All buildings, particularly Buildings 5, 6, 7, 8 within potential clearance distance of overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors are not included on building elevation sheets. Building heights and finished floor elevations are provided (Sheet 21), but no surveyed conductor elevation data or clearance dimension annotations are shown to demonstrate required clearances are met.

applicableAreas: Buildings 5, 6, 7, 8 and associated building projections within clearance distance of overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Section and plan view exhibits do not show clearance dimensions from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of buildings and building projections. No profile sections, elevation details, or enlarged plan details with dimension lines extending from the outer conductor to building edges are provided for clearance verification.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls along eastern and southern property boundaries parallel to overhead electric utility lines
findings.comment: Concrete retaining walls are proposed along the eastern boundary (to replace existing wall) and the southern boundary, located parallel to and within potential clearance distance of overhead electric utility lines shown on the existing conditions survey. No clearance dimensions from the outer electric line to the outermost face of the retaining walls are provided to demonstrate the required 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance is maintained.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls along eastern and southern property boundaries
findings.comment: Section exhibits showing clearance dimension annotations from outer electric conductors to the outermost edges of retaining walls are not provided. The grading plan shows retaining wall elevations and top/bottom of wall elevations but does not include sections demonstrating clearance compliance with UCM § 1.10.3.

applicableAreas: Internal driveways and parking areas adjacent to overhead electric lines on southern and eastern property boundaries
findings.comment: Internal driveways run parallel to the overhead electric lines on the southern and eastern property boundaries, and parking areas are adjacent to these lines. No grading plan sections or profile exhibits are provided showing finished driveway grade elevations with vertical clearance dimensions to the lowest point of the overhead electric facilities. Mid-span clearance data from a registered surveyor is not provided to verify compliance with the 16-foot (without truck traffic) or 18-foot (with truck traffic) minimum vertical clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: Parking areas and parking pads adjacent to overhead electric lines along southern and eastern property boundaries
findings.comment: Parking areas are positioned adjacent to overhead electric utility lines. The plans do not show vertical clearance dimensions from the lowest overhead electric lines (including all conductors and attachments) to the parking pad finish elevations, nor are minimum clearance requirements (12 feet for residential pedestrian areas, 16 feet for parking without trucks, or 18 feet with truck traffic) noted on the site plan.

applicableAreas: Buildings 5, 6, 7, 8, driveways, and parking areas that may not meet minimum vertical clearance requirements from overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Proposed site feature elevations (buildings with FFEs ranging from 683.0 to 687.50; finished driveway grades around 680-686) appear marginal relative to estimated overhead line heights. No registered surveyor mid-span clearance data are provided showing measured vertical clearances from overhead conductors to buildings, driveways, or parking areas to verify compliance with minimum required clearances.

applicableAreas: Landscape plan southern property boundary where overhead electric utility line is routed and five mitigation trees are proposed
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows five mitigation trees (marked 'M') planted along the southern property boundary in proximity to the overhead electric utility line. The specific species of these five trees is not identified on the landscape plan or cross-referenced to the plant schedule on Sheet 35. The proposed tree species for the project (Live Oak, Cedar Elm, Texas Mountain Laurel, Mexican Redbud) are large shade trees that do not appear to be utility-compatible per ECM Appendix F standards. Cannot verify that trees within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors (or 50 lateral feet of transmission conductors per UCM § 1.10.10.4) are from the Utility Compatible list.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet and general notes where overhead electric lines exist on or adjacent to construction site
findings.comment: Required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines (per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003) is not found on the cover sheet or general notes. This notification requirement is mandatory when overhead electric lines exist on or adjacent to a site with construction activities.
